points.text: Divine reward for good deeds is exclusive to believers, not applying to those who do not recognize the authority of Wilayah.
Allah grants comprehensive forgiveness to believers, erasing all their sins upon death or on the Day of Resurrection.
When two believers meet and shake hands, Allah forgives them, showers mercy upon them, and causes their sins to fall away.
Allah shows special affection for believers by delaying the answer to their supplications to increase their reward and by hesitating to take their souls.
The essence of a believer is created from the essence of the Prophets and is safeguarded from becoming wicked.
Allah protects believers from evil, guides their affairs, and ensures their good deeds prepare their reward in Paradise.
The death of a believer is a significant loss to religion, causing the earth, heavens, and angels to mourn.
A believer's dream is a portion of prophethood, and their light shines brightly in the heavens.
